section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for a single study (Study X) consisting of 142 undergraduate women recruited from an Introductory Psychology class via convenience sampling. The sample was predominantly Caucasian (86.9%), with a mean age of 18.68 years, and BMI was assessed through self-reported weight and height (mean BMI = 22.22). No information about body appreciation assessment or correlations is provided in this section.
